reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Galactomyces Glutathione Daily Mask Sheet 30ea
reviews.text: Oops, I did it again… peeled off the aluminium seal instead of making a hole to take the masks out. They say the new box has been improved — and yes, it’s better than the previous one, but the fit is still quite loose. The lid that’s meant to open for use is so stiff that the whole top cover ends up coming off instead… Hope they fix this soon!
reviews.zh: 又嚟料⋯⋯我撕走咗成塊鋁箔封口而唔係拮個窿嚟攞面膜出嚟。佢哋話新包裝已經改良過 — 係，係比以前好少少，但個蓋仲係太鬆。本來用嚟打開攞面膜嗰個蓋實在太緊，搞到成個頂蓋一齊甩埋⋯⋯希望佢哋快啲改好！

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Galactomyces Glutathione Daily Mask Sheet 30ea
reviews.text:
Brightening Made Easy!

The SOME BY MI Galactomyces Glutathione Daily Mask is a total game-changer!

Each sheet is soaked in essence that leaves my skin instantly brighter, smoother, and refreshed without feeling heavy or sticky. I love how gentle it is for daily use, and over time I’ve noticed my complexion looks more even and radiant. 

A must-have for anyone wanting healthy glowing skin! 🌟
reviews.zh:
提亮無難度！

SOME BY MI 酵母菌絲發酵穀胱甘肽日常面膜，簡直係革命性產品！

每塊面膜都浸透精華，用完之後皮膚即時提亮、變得更滑、煥然一新，而且唔會有厚重或者黏笠嘅感覺。我好鍾意佢夠溫和，可以日日用，用咗一段時間之後，發覺膚色均勻咗、更有光澤。

想擁有健康光澤肌嘅人必備！🌟

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Galactomyces Glutathione Daily Mask Sheet 30ea
reviews.text: The box is really hard to open like the other reviews say. I used scissors to cut the protective film and not peel it back all the way. I keep it in the fridge and use it in the mornings but there are definitely better daily masks so I would not purchase again. I don't see a big difference in my skin and the hydration does not last a long time. Not really worth since the box is such a hassle.
reviews.zh: 個盒真係好難開，同其他評價講嘅一樣。我用剪刀剪開保護膜，唔係成塊撕返出嚟。我將佢擺喺雪櫃，朝早用，但係絕對有更好嘅日常面膜，所以唔會再買。我冇見到皮膚有明顯分別，保濕都唔持久。個盒咁麻煩，真係唔值。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Galactomyces Glutathione Daily Mask Sheet 30ea
reviews.text: I’ve been using these masks for a week and I’m seriously impressed. Each sheet is fully drenched in serum, and you can feel the richness of the Galactomyces and Glutathione working right away. My skin feels more hydrated, calm, and noticeably brighter every morning. I also love that there are 30 sheets in one pack — perfect for daily use without feeling wasteful. No irritation at all, and the packaging is super convenient. Will definitely repurchase!
reviews.zh: 我用咗呢啲面膜一個星期，認真覺得好正。每塊面膜都完全浸透精華，酵母菌絲發酵同穀胱甘肽嘅豐盈感即時感受到。每日朝早皮膚都感到更保濕、舒緩，明顯提亮咗。我都好鍾意一包有 30 塊——日日用都唔會覺得嘥。完全冇刺激，包裝亦都好方便。一定會回購！

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Galactomyces Glutathione Daily Mask Sheet 30ea
reviews.text:
Very nice mask, i use it not every day, but twice a week. Very moist, thin mask, really like how my skin looks after, firm and shiny. Also my pimple spots are lighter after 3 use, but they were fresh, so i diside it also makes skin lighter. 
Rilly like the product.
reviews.zh:
非常好嘅面膜，我唔係日日用，一星期用兩次。非常濕潤，薄身嘅面膜，真係好鍾意用完之後皮膚嘅狀態，緊緻有光澤。用咗三次之後，痘痘印都淡咗，但因為啱啱爆完，所以我覺得佢都會令膚色變白。
真係好鍾意呢件產品。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Galactomyces Glutathione Daily Mask Sheet 30ea
reviews.text:
It is an ok daily mask
I have tried much better in the past, for my skin in particular, I find this very mid
It will Hydrate my skin a little but other than that it is not really a game changer
I really like the material of the sheet mask tho, it feels very nice on the skin
reviews.zh:
算係 OK 嘅日常面膜
我之前用過好多比佢好嘅，對我嘅皮膚嚟講，我覺得呢個好一般
佢會幫皮膚少少保濕，但除此之外就真係唔算係革命性產品
不過我真係好鍾意呢塊面膜嘅質料，貼住皮膚嘅感覺好好

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Galactomyces Glutathione Daily Mask Sheet 30ea
reviews.text:
I think the cover has been improved. Flip covet is also improved and no longer damaged. There is also an updated tweezers. However I didn’t peel a foil cover off, made a hole instead as I’m afraid of it become loose fitting after removable of it. 
 This is my 3rd time to purchase this and always love it but now I have a tingling sensation when I use this..Why…
reviews.zh:
我覺得個蓋有改善。翻蓋都有改善，唔再爛。夾子都有更新。不過我冇撕走個鋁箔蓋，改為整窿，因為我怕撕走之後個蓋會變鬆。
我已經第 3 次回購呢件產品，一直都好鍾意，但而家用緊嘅時候有刺痛感覺……點解……
